title: Understanding ROC Curves
text: The ROC curve plots the True Positive Rate (TPR) against the False Positive Rate (FPR) for different threshold values. A model with a curve closer to the top-left corner indicates better performance.

title: Interpreting the ROC Curves
text: Look at the ROC curves for models A, B, and C. Which model's curve is closest to the top-left corner? This model will have the highest TPR for a given FPR.

title: Comparing Models
text: Model C's ROC curve is closest to the top-left corner, followed by Model B, and then Model A. This means Model C has the best performance, followed by B, then A.

title: Ranking the Models
text: Based on the ROC curves, rank the models from most to least preferred.
